rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when endurance means sustained physical effort.

example.english: Running a marathon tests your endurance the most.
example.jyutping: paau2 maa5 laai1 cung4 zeoi3 haau2 jim6 noi6 lik6

rows.note: Choose this when the emphasis is on persistence and continuing despite difficulty rather than physical stamina alone.

example.english: They got through the most difficult period through sheer endurance.
example.traditional: 佢靠毅力捱過最艱難嗰段日子。
example.jyutping: keoi5 kaau3 ngai6 lik6 ngaai4 gwo3 zeoi3 gaan1 naan4 go2 dyun6 jat6 zi2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the ability to tolerate hardship, pain, or unpleasant conditions.

example.english: Looking after a patient for a long time really tests your endurance.
example.traditional: 長期照顧病人真係好考驗忍耐力。
example.jyutping: coeng4 kei4 ziu3 gu3 beng6 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 haau2 jim6 jan2 noi6 lik6
